title: MCP server card
question: Does the site advertise an MCP server?
method: GET /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json. Pass on valid JSON with a name and an endpoint. The path is a community convention this scanner adopts, not part of the MCP specification: the Server Card extension (SEP-2127) recommends publishing the card at <endpoint>/server-card and listing it in /.well-known/ai-catalog.json.

title: API catalog
question: Does the site publish an API catalog linkset?
method: GET /.well-known/api-catalog. Pass on an application/linkset+json or linkset document.

title: OAuth discovery
question: Can an agent discover how to authorize against the site's APIs?
method: GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. Pass when either returns valid JSON metadata.

title: Agent Skills index
question: Does the site publish skills an agent can load?
method: GET /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json. Pass on valid JSON listing at least one skill.

title: A2A agent card
question: Does the site publish an A2A agent card?
method: GET /.well-known/agent-card.json. Pass on valid JSON with name, url and skills fields.
